reasoning: 驗證目標：選取 Edit Favorites 類別時，可刪除全部最愛或逐筆刪除演出者／歌曲名稱條目。為什麼這樣切：與 129 的條款內容重疊，差異僅在類別名稱（Edit Favorites 對 Edit FAVs，已登錄 A-SX17），切分依該唯一差異，本 leaf 由 Edit Favorites 進入。逐筆刪除的 ER 斷言其餘最愛未受影響。刪除前的確認畫面不在此驗證，那是 130 的判準（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Edit Favorites deletes an individual favorite and all of them
tcs.test_item: When the Edit Favorites category is selected, the HU shall enable the user to delete all current favorites or delete individual favorite artist/song title entries
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Three favorites are stored, of which at least one is an artist and at least one is a song title
5. The Favorites browse content is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the Edit Favorites category
2. Delete one individual favorite and read the favorites
3. Delete all current favorites and read the favorites
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Edit Favorites category is accepted as a selection and both deleting an individual entry and deleting all are offered
2. The deleted favorite is gone and the other two are unchanged
3. No favorite remains
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: Same-text sibling: CFTS024-4872930 (category-name entry is the distinguishing token)
